paper.title: You Only Look Once: Unified, Real-Time Object Detection

seed.quote: Instead, we frame object detection as a regression problem to spatially separated bounding boxes and associated class probabilities.

passages.text: ^7f3a91c2 We ^7f3a91c2 present ^7f3a91c2 YOLO, ^7f3a91c2 a ^7f3a91c2 new ^7f3a91c2 approach ^7f3a91c2 to ^7f3a91c2 object ^7f3a91c2 detection. ^7f3a91c2 Prior ^7f3a91c2 work ^7f3a91c2 on ^7f3a91c2 object ^7f3a91c2 detection ^7f3a91c2 repurposes ^7f3a91c2 classifiers ^7f3a91c2 to ^7f3a91c2 perform ^7f3a91c2 detection. ^7f3a91c2 Instead, ^7f3a91c2 we ^7f3a91c2 frame ^7f3a91c2 object ^7f3a91c2 detection ^7f3a91c2 as ^7f3a91c2 a ^7f3a91c2 regression ^7f3a91c2 problem ^7f3a91c2 to ^7f3a91c2 spatially ^7f3a91c2 separated ^7f3a91c2 bounding ^7f3a91c2 boxes ^7f3a91c2 and ^7f3a91c2 associated ^7f3a91c2 class ^7f3a91c2 probabilities. ^7f3a91c2 A ^7f3a91c2 single ^7f3a91c2 neural ^7f3a91c2 network ^7f3a91c2 predicts ^7f3a91c2 bounding ^7f3a91c2 boxes ^7f3a91c2 and ^7f3a91c2 class ^7f3a91c2 probabilities ^7f3a91c2 directly ^7f3a91c2 from ^7f3a91c2 full ^7f3a91c2 images ^7f3a91c2 in ^7f3a91c2 one ^7f3a91c2 evaluation. ^7f3a91c2

passages.text: ^7f3a91c2 Current ^7f3a91c2 detection ^7f3a91c2 systems ^7f3a91c2 repurpose ^7f3a91c2 classifiers ^7f3a91c2 to ^7f3a91c2 perform ^7f3a91c2 detection. ^7f3a91c2 More ^7f3a91c2 recent ^7f3a91c2 approaches ^7f3a91c2 like ^7f3a91c2 R-CNN ^7f3a91c2 use ^7f3a91c2 region ^7f3a91c2 proposal ^7f3a91c2 methods ^7f3a91c2 to ^7f3a91c2 first ^7f3a91c2 generate ^7f3a91c2 potential ^7f3a91c2 bounding ^7f3a91c2 boxes ^7f3a91c2 in ^7f3a91c2 an ^7f3a91c2 image ^7f3a91c2 and ^7f3a91c2 then ^7f3a91c2 run ^7f3a91c2 a ^7f3a91c2 classifier ^7f3a91c2 on ^7f3a91c2 these ^7f3a91c2 proposed ^7f3a91c2 boxes. ^7f3a91c2
